scope: Next twenty unreviewed alirezarezvani__claude-skills__ originals in frozen cohort order; prerequisite review only.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked scripts, assets and references were not read or executed; their behavior and availability are not independently verified.

sources.workflow: Compare roster and account exports, check review-campaign coverage and remediation, and map exceptions to controls.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Roster, account and campaign exports, policy periods, relevant dates, and the described scripts.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied exports and policy values permit an offline assessment; actual account removal requires a fresh authoritative export and audit conclusions require human judgment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An access-control reviewer or auditor should verify export completeness, remediation and control conclusions.

sources.workflow: Generate, iterate or scale platform-specific ad copy and check it against the stated quality criteria.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Product, offer, audience, platform and funnel context; performance data and existing copy when iterating.
sources.offline_assessment: Draft copy and character-count checks are possible from supplied context; platform approval and campaign performance require actual platform and performance evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A marketer should verify claims and audience fit; the platform and campaign results determine actual approval and performance.

sources.workflow: Grade trajectories, detect flaky cases and compare candidate and baseline using paired regression gates.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Repeated baseline and candidate trial records, case specifications, clean trial environments and the described scripts.
sources.offline_assessment: Existing trial records can support offline statistical and trajectory analysis; genuine trial results require running the relevant agents and tools.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An evaluation owner should verify trial provenance, case coverage, statistical interpretation and any warning-based release decision.

sources.workflow: Turn requirements into stories and acceptance criteria, split epics, prioritize backlog and plan sprint capacity.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Requirements, personas, priorities, team velocity and availability; the described generator is needed for its scripted output.
sources.offline_assessment: Stories and capacity calculations can be drafted from supplied inputs; actual completion requires implemented work, tests, staging and product-owner acceptance.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The product owner and delivery team should validate estimates, acceptance criteria and completion evidence.

sources.workflow: Classify each decision by reversibility, exposure and frequency, then assign AI, collaborative or human authority.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A decision or workflow list and enough information about its consequences, exposure and frequency.
sources.offline_assessment: Zone classifications and policy drafts can be evaluated from supplied scenarios; actual permission boundaries and approvals require organizational evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A governance owner should review classifications, actual permissions and required human approval.

sources.workflow: Administer users, groups, permissions, SSO, integrations and organization governance, with post-change verification.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An organization, authorized administrative access, user and group details, and applicable identity-provider and integration configuration.
sources.offline_assessment: Change plans and permission reviews can be drafted offline; provisioning, deprovisioning, SSO and integration verification require the actual service and users.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An authorized administrator or security reviewer should independently inspect resulting access, logs and user tests.

sources.workflow: Assemble a board or investor deck with functional perspectives, metrics, narrative, risks and specific asks.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Meeting cadence and company stage, available current metrics, targets and functional updates; missing numbers should remain placeholders.
sources.offline_assessment: A draft deck and narrative are possible from supplied records; factual accuracy, board delivery and decisions require current organizational evidence and participants.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Functional owners and the executive team should validate metrics, forecasts, risks and board asks.

sources.workflow: Investigate a quality event, determine root cause, plan corrective actions, monitor effectiveness and report CAPA status.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Trigger-event evidence, relevant records, an investigation team, action owners, baseline and post-implementation data.
sources.offline_assessment: An investigation plan and analysis of supplied records are possible offline; implementation and effectiveness require actual process evidence over the verification period.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The named CAPA owner and Quality function must review closure; Regulatory Affairs handles regulatory classification.

sources.workflow: Advise on model build versus buy, AI risk classification, hosting economics and hiring sequence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Use-case, workload, quality, latency, cost, geography, team and budget inputs appropriate to the decision.
sources.offline_assessment: Scenario calculations and advisory drafts are possible from supplied assumptions; actual costs, technical performance and applicable legal obligations require current external and organizational evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Finance and technical owners should verify assumptions and results; qualified counsel should assess binding compliance decisions.

sources.workflow: Classify assessment scope, score requirements and check corrective-plan eligibility and closeout.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Asset inventory, complete requirement assessment, system security plan, corrective-plan records and relevant dates.
sources.offline_assessment: Readiness calculations can be prepared from supplied records; actual control implementation, assessment and affirmation cannot be established by the scripts alone.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The appropriate assessor should evaluate evidence and the designated official should make the affirmation.

sources.workflow: Review rollout guardrails, approved components, instruction layering and team adoption counts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Repository and managed settings, an approved-component list, member-generated adoption counts and the described scripts.
sources.offline_assessment: Configuration and count analysis can be performed offline with supplied inputs; deployed managed policy and actual adoption need endpoint and participant evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A rollout or security owner should verify deployed settings, approvals and aggregated adoption evidence.

sources.workflow: Route a commercial inquiry to one relevant sub-skill, clarify ambiguous lanes and return a decision-support digest.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A commercial inquiry and relevant deal, pricing, proposal or pipeline inputs; the routed sub-skill and its context are needed for its full analysis.
sources.offline_assessment: Routing and a draft digest can be assessed from supplied examples; a full routed analysis depends on the referenced sub-skill and real commercial inputs.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A commercial authority should validate assumptions and approve any price, discount or agreement.

sources.workflow: Plan a commit series, gate staged changes for secrets, lint messages and verify the series before push.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A repository or diff, staged changes and messages, Git and the described scripts; per-commit build evidence is also required.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied diff can support a commit plan and static review; actual staging, commits and per-commit builds require repository operations and runtime evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A developer or reviewer should inspect the staged contents, test each commit and decide on any history rewrite.

sources.workflow: Identify and track competitors, analyze positioning and feature gaps, conduct win-loss analysis and distribute intelligence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Competitor identities, current product and market information, deal outcomes and interview access for win-loss analysis.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied records can support a landscape draft and analysis; current competitive moves and interviews require real source and participant evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A competitive-intelligence owner should corroborate current claims and an independent interviewer should validate win-loss findings.

sources.workflow: Research competitors, build centralized comparison data and draft alternative or versus pages.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Product positioning, competitor details, pricing, target audience, page goals and verifiable customer or public evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: Page structures and copy can be drafted from supplied evidence; current product use, competitor pricing, customer interviews and publication need actual external or human evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A product marketer should verify comparisons and claims before publication, with legal review where appropriate.

sources.workflow: Design and create documentation spaces, page hierarchies and templates, audit content and govern permissions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Team information, page inventory, appropriate service access and permissions, and the described tooling for selected operations.
sources.offline_assessment: A hierarchy, templates and inventory analysis can be drafted offline; space creation, page rendering and non-admin permission tests require the real service.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A space administrator and representative non-admin user should verify rendered content, hierarchy and effective permissions.

sources.workflow: Load and assess company context, flag missing or stale fields, propose updates and anonymize material before external use.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A company context file or user-provided context, its update date and user confirmation before modifying it.
sources.offline_assessment: Staleness, completeness and anonymization can be assessed against supplied context offline; actual updates require consent and external disclosures require boundary-specific verification.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The context owner should approve changes and a privacy reviewer should check any proposed external disclosure.

sources.workflow: Pressure-test a revenue plan across pipeline, win rates, retention, ramp, discounts and source mix.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A plan and current and historical pipeline, conversion, retention, hiring, discount and source data.
sources.offline_assessment: A review and calculations can be drafted from supplied data; actual forecast reliability depends on genuine, current sales records and organizational decisions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Revenue operations and the CRO should validate data, assumptions, thresholds and resulting actions.

sources.workflow: Classify tasks, budget shallow work, time-block the day, log focus sessions and perform shutdown.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Task list with estimated durations, shallow-work budget, fixed day boundaries and actual session durations for logging.
sources.offline_assessment: A schedule and budget can be assessed from supplied tasks; actual focus sessions, adherence and shutdown require participant evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: The participant should confirm real task classification, completed focus time and any schedule revisions.

sources.workflow: Verify extraction, reconstruct claims and argument relationships, build an evidence ledger, critique reasoning and optionally test comprehension.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Supplied readable source material with usable location markers; complete book analysis requires the complete book.
sources.offline_assessment: Argument reconstruction and evidence mapping are possible from complete supplied material; retrieval-based learning verification requires an actual reader response.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A source-aware reviewer should check the ledger and citations; the reader's unaided explanation tests their own comprehension.

source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
